messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

1) the **email** on your order, **or**
2) your **first name + last name + ZIP code**.

Also, please share your **order ID** (it looks like `#W0000000`).  
Once I look up the order, I’ll confirm the items you want to **return everything except the tablet** and calculate what the refund would be (and what payment method it will go back to).
Sure! My name is Yusuf Gonzalez and my zip code is 91455. I don’t remember my email address, but I can give you my order ID if you need it.
yusuf_gonzalez_8900

Then I’ll confirm which item(s) are **tablet** vs **E-Reader**, and I’ll tell you **how much you’ll be refunded** and to **which payment method** (gift card or original payment).
